title: District corporal punishment policies for one state

source.description: URL of the board policy, handbook, or official record that establishes the status

quote.description: Verbatim sentence from the source that establishes the status

crdc_students_latest.description: Students receiving CP in the latest CRDC year

phone_policy.description: Student cell phone rule from the handbook or board policy: bell_to_bell_ban = phones off and stored for the whole school day; classroom_ban = prohibited during instruction, allowed at lunch/passing; teacher_discretion = each teacher decides; allowed = generally permitted with limits; unknown = no policy sentence found

ai_policy.description: Generative AI rule: prohibited = students may not use AI tools for schoolwork; permitted_with_guidance = allowed when the teacher or assignment permits, with a stated policy; academic_integrity_only = mentioned only inside the cheating/plagiarism rule; no_policy = handbook was read in full and says nothing; unknown = could not determine

archived_url.description: Wayback Machine capture of `source`, taken at scan time

document_text_path.description: Path in this repo to the extracted text of the discipline section, e.g. data/policies/AL/0100540.md

start_times.description: Bell schedule for the district's secondary schools. Adolescent sleep research and the AAP recommend secondary schools start no earlier than 8:30.

start.description: First bell / start of instruction, local time, e.g. '7:45'
First bell / start of instruction, local time, e.g. '7:45'

legacy_status.description: A status carried over from the pre-2026 map that was never sourced. Kept only to prioritise re-scanning; never published as fact.

contact.description: Official published contact for the district, taken from the district's own website while scanning its policy. Public record only: the general/superintendent office, the board clerk, the address and phone a member of the public is invited to use. Never a personal address, never a scraped social account, never an individual staff member who is not the published point of contact.

district_email.description: General or superintendent's office email as published

board_email.description: Board or board clerk email as published

board_page.description: URL of the board page listing members and meeting times

contact_page.description: URL the contact was read from, so it can be rechecked

public_comment.description: How the public signs up to speak at a board meeting, if published

as_of.description: Date read (YYYY-MM-DD), or the school year of the federal file the contact came from (e.g. 2023-24)

website.description: District's own website as published in the federal LEA directory or on the district's site

source.description: Where this contact block was read: a district page, or the federal LEA directory file it came out of

policy_adopted.description: Date the corporal punishment policy was originally adopted, as the policy itself prints it (YYYY-MM-DD). The policy's own date, not the date we read it and not the handbook's publication date.

policy_revised.description: Date the corporal punishment policy was last revised or reissued, as the policy itself prints it (YYYY-MM-DD). For TASB this is the LOCAL section's DATE ISSUED.

policy_dates_from.description: Where policy_adopted/policy_revised came from: 'policy' means a contributor read them off the policy, 'notes' means they were extracted from an existing note by tools/dates/extract.mjs and are weaker evidence.
